# CmisVcs10ParameterId — CMIS-VCS 1.0 VCS Parameter ID

- Schema: `openxcvr.enum.v2` (kind `enum`), id `CmisVcs10ParameterId`
- Description: Versatile Control Set Parameter ID registry, OIF-CMIS-VCS-01.0 § 5 Table 5-1. Each VCS Parameter is advertised by the module inside the VCS Descriptor (a TLV encoded byte array returned by the VCS Descriptor CDB commands, § 6) and occupies a module-advertised position inside the Control Set memory spaces (§ 4.4); the ID itself is not a memory address. Every entry records the parameter's Control Set register format as tags: register field name, data type, size in bits per lane and access, plus the descriptor attributes beyond the common set (VCS Parameter ID, VCS Parameter Length, ApplicationMask, MemoryLength). Register placement inside the VCS spaces is advertisement data and is not recorded.

| 0x00 | `reserved_space_indicator` | — | Used to reserve memory space for unused parameters so a CMIS base 5.x host still sees the Control Set layout it expects; the ReservedLength attribute gives the length in bytes of the unsupported parameter (§ 5.2). Descriptor attributes: VCS Parameter ID, VCS Parameter Length, ApplicationMask (ignored for this parameter), ReservedLength. No register field: the reserved bytes read back as the CMIS base reserved content and writes have no effect. |

Register: ExplicitControlPerParam&lt;i&gt;, Bool, RW, size in bits per lane equals the advertised ExplicitControlPerParamMask length (number of advertised VCS Parameters, rounded up to a byte). Descriptor attributes: VCS Parameter ID, VCS Parameter Length, ApplicationMask, MemoryLength, ExplicitControlPerParamMask. |
